tagline: A traditional European side district famous for its leather and textile industries — functional rather than scenic, but home to excellent fabric markets.

items.name: Zeytinburnu Lokantalari
items.description: Honest, working-class lokanta restaurants serving traditional Turkish food at very low prices. Popular with factory and market workers.

items.name: Zeytinburnu Deri Piyasası
items.description: A large leather goods market with wholesale and retail leather products. One of Istanbul's main leather trade centres.

items.name: Yedikule Hisarları
items.description: The Fortress of the Seven Towers — a Byzantine-Ottoman fortification at the end of the Theodosian Walls. Worth visiting for history enthusiasts.

tips: Zeytinburnu is on the T1 tram line — easily accessible from the city centre.
Come for the leather market or Yedikule fortress, not for dining or cafés.
The Theodosian city walls run through this area — walk a section for a perspective on Byzantine Istanbul.
Bakırköy (two tram stops west) is a much better area for leisure and dining.
